questions.question: The papers' pre-root push of b770, before the root. The papers' gated push of push-b770-preroot, whose tip 9f0ebf1f carries this act's seven papers' commits with the FINDINGS text, was refused by the table check and nothing was pushed: the terminal table regenerated in memory moves one grade cell against the relay's committed table, SIDE-explicit-formula / SIDEExplicitFormula.B321.rh_imp_h2_sign from DERIVES to CONFLICT, and the face carries no TABLE CELL line naming it. The cause: the table's cell reader takes a capital grade word within 120 characters of a backticked name as that name's grade cell, and [D1], written at OPEN_TRAILS :19607 as the ruling's text with its fields filled, names `rh_imp_h2_sign` and then the grade INTERFACES, which [D1] gives the new statements; the row then holds two DERIVES cells and one INTERFACES cell. The table check was written for b568's defect (k), an act's own ledger line read as a grade cell, and it lets a moved cell through only where the face names it; the face is locked, and G-TABLE-FINAL will read the move as failing at both suites, as at b706. My pre-root commit took b769's list of paths, and b769's final table moved nothing, so the regenerated table was left out; b758, b759, b762, b763 and b765 each committed theirs in a pre-root commit. The relay's main is pushed and read back at 07e2f914, and the ceiling is 2026-11-28T03:01:37Z. Which route for the papers' pushes?

options.label: Commit the table, then push (Recommended)
options.description: data/terminal_table.json, as the final table's route wrote it and named in this act's (W) list, committed alone by the one-call tool in a pre-root commit, as b758, b759, b762, b763 and b765 committed theirs, its .md, _prior.json, _run.txt and _diff.json left unstaged; the papers' gated push sent again, the check then reading against that table; the moved cell printed in the closing for the navigator, and G-TABLE-FINAL reading it failing. N4's reading of edits after the lock takes the face, the tools and this act's banks tracked at the lock, and the table is none of them. The misses bank's item (7), which said the seat stages none of the table's files, no longer holds for this one file. The tracked table then carries the CONFLICT reading until a later act settles the wording or the reader.

options.label: Name the cell on the face
options.description: One Edit of the face after the lock adds the line TABLE CELL: SIDE-explicit-formula / SIDEExplicitFormula.B321.rh_imp_h2_sign, and the papers' gated push is sent again; the relay's committed table stays as it is. This costs N4, whose clause reads that no face is edited after the lock gate, and the face no longer matches the sha256 that the gate banks stamped.

options.label: Hold the papers' pushes
options.description: Nothing committed for the table, and the face left as locked; this act's seven papers' commits stay on push-b770-preroot unpushed, the papers' remote at 78685602; the close goes on for the relay through the root, the record, the mirror, the Project set and the closing, with the papers' record push held too; the moved cell and this finding go to the tip's ruling. The papers' text of this act is then not on its remote at the close.

options.label: Another route
options.description: You name the route in your own words; the close waits before the root, nothing committed, moved or pushed for the papers until then.
